# function: render_meraki_model

Processes a Meraki Network as Code model and applies network and device templates. YAML strings and the HCL model are merged first, then for every network (`meraki.domains[].organizations[].networks[]`) the templates listed in `templates` are looked up in `meraki.templates.networks`, rendered and merged in list order, with the network's own configuration taking precedence. Afterwards the same is done for every device of every network (`networks[].devices[]`, including devices added by network templates) using `meraki.templates.devices`.

Templates are either of type `model` (inline `configuration`, where every string value is rendered as a template) or of type `file` (a template file referenced by `file`, whose content must be provided via `file_templates`, rendered and decoded as YAML).

The following variables are available in templates:

- Network templates: `GLOBAL` (the `meraki` section of the merged model) and the network's `variables`.
- Device templates: `GLOBAL`, the parent network's `variables` (after network templates have been applied) and the device's `variables`, where device variables take precedence over network variables.

Only template content is rendered, `${}` expressions in the regular configuration are left untouched. Returns an error if the same attribute is a different kind of value (map, list, or scalar) in a template and in the configuration.

The result contains the rendered model with `!env` tags preserved (`raw`), the rendered model with `!env` tags resolved (`resolved`) and the merged default values (`defaults`). Variables with `!env` tags can be used within strings (e.g. `Bearer ${token}`): they are resolved in `resolved` and kept unresolved in `raw`. The `meraki.templates` section is not included in the rendered model.

~> This function is intended for use within the [Network as Code](https://netascode.cisco.com/) Terraform modules and is not intended for standalone use.

## Template Functions

The following functions are available inside `${}` template expressions in model and file templates:

**Numeric:** `abs`, `ceil`, `floor`, `log`, `max`, `min`, `parseint`, `pow`, `signum`, `sum`

**String:** `chomp`, `endswith`, `format`, `formatlist`, `indent`, `join`, `lower`, `regex`, `regexall`, `regexreplace`, `replace`, `sort`, `split`, `startswith`, `strcontains`, `strlen`, `substr`, `title`, `trim`, `trimprefix`, `trimsuffix`, `trimspace`, `upper`

**Collection:** `chunklist`, `coalesce`, `coalescelist`, `compact`, `concat`, `contains`, `distinct`, `element`, `flatten`, `index`, `keys`, `length`, `lookup`, `merge`, `one`, `range`, `reverse`, `setintersection`, `setproduct`, `setsubtract`, `setunion`, `slice`, `values`, `zipmap`

**Type Conversion:** `tobool`, `tonumber`, `tostring`

**Encoding:** `base64decode`, `base64encode`, `csvdecode`, `jsondecode`, `jsonencode`

**Date/Time:** `formatdate`, `timeadd`

**Boolean:** `alltrue`, `anytrue`

**Error Handling:** `try`, `can`

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    utils = {
      source = "netascode/utils"
    }
  }
}

provider "utils" {}

locals {
  model = {
    meraki = {
      templates = {
        networks = [
          {
            name = "branch"
            type = "model"
            configuration = {
              time_zone     = "Europe/Berlin"
              notes         = "Branch $${site_id}"
              product_types = ["appliance", "switch"]
            }
          }
        ]
        devices = [
          {
            name = "switch"
            type = "model"
            configuration = {
              address = "$${address}"
              tags    = ["$${role}"]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
      domains = [
        {
          name = "EMEA"
          organizations = [
            {
              name = "Org1"
              networks = [
                {
                  name      = "Branch1"
                  templates = ["branch"]
                  variables = {
                    site_id = 1
                    address = "Main Street 1"
                  }
                  devices = [
                    {
                      serial    = "Q2XX-XXXX-XXXX"
                      name      = "SW1"
                      templates = ["switch"]
                      variables = {
                        role = "access"
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }

  result = provider::utils::render_meraki_model([], local.model, "", {})
}

# Fully rendered network including its devices
output "network" {
  value = local.result.resolved.meraki.domains[0].organizations[0].networks[0]
}

/*
network = {
  "devices" = [
    {
      "address"   = "Main Street 1"
      "name"      = "SW1"
      "serial"    = "Q2XX-XXXX-XXXX"
      "tags"      = ["access"]
      "templates" = ["switch"]
      "variables" = {
        "role" = "access"
      }
    },
  ]
  "name"          = "Branch1"
  "notes"         = "Branch 1"
  "product_types" = ["appliance", "switch"]
  "templates"     = ["branch"]
  "time_zone"     = "Europe/Berlin"
  "variables" = {
    "address" = "Main Street 1"
    "site_id" = 1
  }
}
*/
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
render_meraki_model(yaml_strings list of string, model dynamic, defaults_yaml string, file_templates dynamic) object
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `yaml_strings` (List of String) List of YAML strings to decode and merge into the base model.
1. `model` (Dynamic) HCL model variable to merge on top of the YAML strings.
1. `defaults_yaml` (String) Module defaults YAML string. User defaults from model override these.
1. `file_templates` (Dynamic) Map of file path to pre-read file content for file-type templates.
